models.name: multi_user_todo_app_guests
models.description:
Guest user accounts for unauthenticated visitors to the multi-user todo application.

This table stores temporary guest identities identified by email and password, allowing unauthenticated users to access the system before completing registration. Each guest account is associated with a specific device through session tracking in the multi_user_todo_app_guest_sessions table.

Key relationships:
- One-to-many with multi_user_todo_app_guest_sessions for session tracking
- Guests can upgrade to member accounts via email/password registration

Business context:
- Guest accounts serve as entry point for unauthenticated users
- Guest data is isolated from member data
- Guest accounts are created during initial app access
- Passwords are hashed for security before storage
- Soft delete capability for account lifecycle management

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Guest email address used for identification and authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for guest account authentication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last guest account update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of soft deletion, null when active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_app_guest_sessions
models.description:
Temporary session tokens for guest access using device_id and fingerprint.

This table tracks unauthenticated visitor sessions to maintain state across requests before guest registration. Each session is linked to a guest account via device fingerprint for session continuity and security.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to {@link multi_user_todo_app_guests} - one guest can have multiple active sessions
- Sessions expire based on expired_at timestamp for security
- Managed through authentication middleware, not direct user CRUD

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_app_guest_id
foreignFields.description: Guest account this session belongs to. {@link multi_user_todo_app_guests.id}

plainFields.name: device_id
plainFields.description: Device identifier for guest session continuity across requests.

plainFields.name: fingerprint
plainFields.description: Device fingerprint hash for session security and fraud detection.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Last known page URL for session context.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL from the request for session source tracking.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for security cleanup.

models.name: multi_user_todo_app_members
models.description:
Registered member user accounts with email/password authentication credentials.

This table serves as the primary identity record for authenticated members in the system. Each member account stores the email address and hashed password required for authentication, along with temporal tracking fields for audit and soft delete capabilities.

Members are distinct from guests in that they have persistent accounts that can be authenticated and can access their private todo list, edit history, and trash functionality. This table is referenced by the multi_user_todo_app_member_sessions table for session management and multi_user_todo_app_member_password_resets for password reset flows.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address used for member login and account identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt-hashed password string for member authentication. Never stored in plaintext.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. NULL indicates active account, non-NULL indicates deleted account awaiting permanent removal.

models.name: multi_user_todo_app_member_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support.

This table tracks all active member login sessions, storing authentication tokens and connection metadata for security auditing. Each session represents a single authenticated device/browser combination with a unique JWT access token and refresh token pair.

**Key Relationships:**
- Belongs to one member: {@link multi_user_todo_app_members} (via multi_user_todo_app_member_id)
- Multiple sessions per member allowed (mobile, web, tablet)
- Sessions are append-only audit records - never modified after creation

**Session Lifecycle:**
- Created on successful member login
- Tokens stored for refresh and re-authentication
- Expired sessions are identified by expired_at timestamp
- Member logout or password changes may invalidate sessions

**Security Considerations:**
- Access tokens used for API authentication
- Refresh tokens used to obtain new access tokens
- Connection metadata (IP, referrer) stored for fraud detection
- Multiple concurrent sessions supported per member

**Usage Pattern:**
- Members can maintain multiple active sessions simultaneously
- Sessions are managed through authentication flows, not direct CRUD
- Expired_at field enables automatic cleanup of stale sessions

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_app_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link multi_user_todo_app_members.id}. Required for session ownership and token validation.

plainFields.name: access_token
plainFields.description: JWT access token for API authentication. Used to authorize member requests. Stored as hash for security.

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens. Valid until expired_at timestamp.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from request headers. Used for connection metadata and security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URL path from browser. Captures which page/route triggered the login.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer header value. Used to track login source and detect suspicious redirects.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp. When the member successfully authenticated and this session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. After this time, tokens are invalid. Security: NOT NULL by default.

models.name: multi_user_todo_app_member_password_resets
models.description:
Password reset tokens for member account recovery flow.

Stores temporary cryptographic tokens that members receive when requesting password reset via email. Each token is tied to a specific member account and expires after a configured time window (typically 1-24 hours). This table enables secure password recovery without exposing the member's actual password.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to exactly one {@link multi_user_todo_app_members} account via member_id
- Tokens are single-use: when a reset is completed, the token is marked as deleted
- Expired tokens remain in the table until garbage collection (soft delete pattern)

Behavioral notes:
- Only one active reset token per member at a time (enforced by unique member_id constraint)
- Requesting a new reset automatically invalidates previous tokens
- Tokens are never stored in plain text; only hashed values are used for comparison
- The table maintains audit trail of all reset attempts including successful, expired, and unused tokens

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member account's {@link multi_user_todo_app_members.id} that requested the password reset.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographic reset token value. This is a hashed representation of the actual token sent to the member's email. The plain token is generated during reset request and compared against this hashed value during validation.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reset token expires and becomes invalid. Tokens typically expire after 1-24 hours depending on security configuration. Must not be null to enforce token lifecycle.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when this reset token was generated and sent to the member.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this reset token record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. When null, token is active. When set, token has been consumed (password reset completed), expired, or manually invalidated.

models.name: multi_user_todo_app_todos
models.description:
Main todo entity for authenticated member accounts.

Represents individual todo items that members create and manage in their private todo list. Each todo has a title, optional description, optional start date, optional due date, and completion status. Supports soft delete for trash functionality where deleted todos are hidden from normal list but can be restored or permanently removed.

Key relationships:
- Belongs to one member via user_id {@link multi_user_todo_app_members.id}
- Has many edit history entries {@link multi_user_todo_app_todo_edit_histories.id}

Behavioral notes:
- Soft delete: deleted_at is null for active todos, non-null for trash items
- New todos are created with is_completed = false by default
- Members can only see and manage their own todos (enforced by user_id foreign key)

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title. Required field.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional todo description. Defaults to empty string.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Whether the todo is completed. Defaults to false.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Todo creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last todo update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Null for active todos, non-null for trash items.

models.name: multi_user_todo_app_todo_edit_histories
models.description:
Audit trail table that captures every edit made to todos, storing before and after values for all editable fields.

This snapshot table serves as a complete history log for todo modifications, enabling users to review changes over time. Each edit creates a new history entry with old and new values for title, description, start_date, and due_date fields.

The table maintains referential integrity through foreign keys to the owning todo and the user who performed the edit. Entries are typically queried in descending order by edited_at to show the most recent changes first.

foreignFields.name: todo_id
foreignFields.description: The todo that was edited. {@link multi_user_todo_app_todos.id}

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who performed the edit. {@link multi_user_todo_app_members.id}

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the edit occurred. Used for sorting history entries by recency.

plainFields.name: old_title
plainFields.description: Title value before the edit. Null if title was added in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: Title value after the edit. Null if title was removed in this edit.

plainFields.name: old_description
plainFields.description: Description value before the edit. Null if description was added in this edit.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: Description value after the edit. Null if description was removed in this edit.

plainFields.name: old_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date value before the edit. Null if start_date was added or was null before this edit.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: Start date value after the edit. Null if start_date was removed or set to null in this edit.

plainFields.name: old_due_date
plainFields.description: Due date value before the edit. Null if due_date was added or was null before this edit.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: Due date value after the edit. Null if due_date was removed or set to null in this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp. Used for auditing and chronological ordering.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp. Maintained for consistency with other tables.
